blocks.text: Hydrogen aur doosre halke anasir mein electrons ki tabdeeliyan infrared, nazar aane wali ya ultraviolet mein spectral lakeerein deti hain, kyunke un ke levels ke darmiyan tawanai ka farq chhota hai. Bhari atoms mein electrons K, L, M, N, O waghera naam ke hum-markaz khol (shells) mein hain, K khol nucleus ke sab se qareeb (Fig 20.3). Andaruni khol ke electrons mazbooti se bandhe hain aur unhein nikalne ke liye bohat tawanai chahiye. Excited atom apni aam halat mein wapas aaye to zyada tawanai ke photons nikalte hain: bhari atoms mein andaruni khol ke electrons ki tabdeeliyan zyada tawanai ke photons, X-rays, deti hain. Yeh X-rays khaas wavelengths ki hain aur characteristic X-rays kehlati hain; in ke mutale ne atom ki banawat aur periodic table samajhne mein bohat ahem kirdar ada kiya. Fig 20.4 electromagnetic spectrum mein X-rays ki jagah dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Nucleus ke gird chaar dashed daire, shells K, L, M aur N. Neeche baen se aane wala tez electron (Incident) K shell ke electron se takrata hai; K electron oopar nikal jata (Ejected electron) aur aane wala electron daen taraf mur jata hai (Scattered electron).
blocks.caption: Figure 20.3: hum-markaz tawanai ke khol (concentric energy shells) (kitab ki Figure 20.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tez electron K shell ke electron se takrata hai: K electron bahar nikal jata (ejected) aur aane wala electron mur kar aage chala jata (scattered). K shell ki khali jagah L ya M shell ka electron bharta hai aur K-alpha ya K-beta X-ray nikalti hai (equations 20.2 aur 20.3).

blocks.alt: Electromagnetic spectrum rangeen patti ki shakal mein, jis par lehar ki wavelength daen taraf chhoti hoti jati hai; baen se: radio waves, microwaves, infrared radiation, visible light (patli patti), ultraviolet, X-rays aur gamma-rays, saath radio, microwave oven, remote, bulb, Sooraj aur radiation ke nishan ki chhoti tasaveer. Scale metre mein: 10^3, 1, 10^-3, 10^-5, 10^-7, 10^-9, 10^-11.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.4: electromagnetic spectrum (kitab ki Figure 20.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki shakal mein 10^3 se 1 aur 1 se 10^-3 tak teen teen darje (powers of ten) hain magar aage do do, phir bhi nishan barabar faasle par chhape gaye hain. Hum ne har das guna farq ko barabar faasle par rakha hai; is liye nazar aane wali roshni (taqreeban 4 x 10^-7 se 7 x 10^-7 m) sirf patli patti hai. Scale par wavelength metre mein hai, aur daen taraf wavelength chhoti aur photon ki tawanai zyada hoti hai.

X-rays bohat khali (high vacuum) X-ray tube mein banti hain (Fig 20.5). Cathode C filament F se garam ho kar electrons chhorta hai, jo anode T ki taraf tez kiye jate hain. Agar C aur T ke darmiyan potential difference V ho to electron target se jis zyada se zyada kinetic energy se takrata hai woh (K.E.)max = Ve (20.1) hai. Yeh tez electrons tungsten ya kisi aur bhari element ke target se takrate hain, aur kuch sab se andaruni khol, K ya L, ke electrons nikal dete hain. Agar K khol ka electron nikal jaye aur khala reh jaye to L khol ka electron khala mein koodta aur K-alpha X-ray naam ka photon chhorta hai: h f(K-alpha) = EL - EK (20.2). Is ke bajaye M khol ka electron khala bhar sakta hai, jis se K-beta X-ray milti hai: h f(K-beta) = EM - EK (20.3). Andaruni khol ki tabdeeliyon ke yeh photons characteristic X-rays kehlate hain, kyunke un ki tawanaiyan target ke maddah par munhasir hain. L aur M khol mein bane khala oonchi levels ke electrons bharte hain, jis se mazeed X-rays banti hain. Characteristic X-rays musalsal spectrum par alag lakeeron ki shakal mein nazar aati hain (Fig 20.6).

blocks.alt: Khali shishe ki tube. Baen taraf cathode C mein pech-dar filament (Filament); nuqtedar electron shuaein tube ke paar dhalwan wale tungsten target (Tungsten anode) tak jati hain jo daen taraf cooling channels wale block mein laga hai. Lehriya X-rays target ki satah se neeche tube se bahar nikalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.5: X-rays banane ka intizam (kitab ki Figure 20.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Filament garam ho kar cathode C se electrons nikalta hai; C aur T ke darmiyan V volt se tez ho kar yeh electrons (nuqtedar lakeerein) tungsten anode se takrate aur X-rays nikalti hain. Anode cathode ke muqable musbat hota hai. Anode bohat garam ho jata hai, is liye cooling channels mein thanda karne wala maddah chalta hai.

Musalsal spectrum bremsstrahlung, yani braking radiation, ki wajah se hai. Jab tez electrons target se takrate hain to achanak dheeme ho jate hain, aur raftar badalta (dheema hota) charge electromagnetic shuaein chhorta hai. Raftar ki kami itni zyada hai ke shuaon ki wavelength chhoti, X-ray ki had mein, hoti hai. Agar electron pehli takkar mein apni tamam kinetic energy kho de to woh sab aik X-ray photon ban jati hai jis ki tawanai h f_max hai: (K.E.)max = h f_max. Yeh Fig 20.6 ki sab se chhoti wavelength, lambda_min, hai jo eV = hc/lambda_min se milti hai. Doosre electrons kai takkaron mein tawanai khote hain, jis se kam tawanai (lambi wavelength) ke photons bante aur musalsal spectrum banta hai.

blocks.alt: Intensity aur wavelength (nm) ka graph, nishan 0, 0.04, 0.08 aur 0.12. Curve 0.04 nm par lambda-min tak sifar, phir uth kar kandha (shoulder) banata, 0.057 aur 0.063 nm ke qareeb do tez chotiyan dikhata, aur lambi wavelength par ahista girta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.6: wavelength ke saath X-rays ki shiddat (kitab ki Figure 20.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Musalsal hissa bremsstrahlung hai jo lambda_min se shuru hota hai, jahan eV = hc/lambda_min. Do tez chotiyan characteristic lakeerein hain: chhoti wavelength wali (bayen) K-beta aur oonchi (daen) K-alpha.

Jism se guzarte hue X-rays atoms se amal kar ke tawanai khoti hain; ise attenuation kehte hain. X-rays atoms ko ionise kar ke electrons nikal sakti hain, isi tarah tawanai muntaqil hoti hai. Shua ki shiddat maddah ki motai ke saath exponential tor par ghatti hai: I = Io e^(-mu x), jahan Io ibtidai shiddat, I maddah se guzarne ke baad shiddat, x motai (metre mein) aur mu attenuation coefficient hai, jo maddah aur X-ray ki tawanai par munhasir hai. Usi waqt ki X-ray imaging (fluoroscopy) mein image intensifiers use hote hain; yeh tasveer roshan kar ke shuaon ka samna kam karte hain.

blocks.title: Contrast
blocks.text: X-ray tasveer mein contrast yeh hai ke mukhtalif tissues kitni wazahat se alag pehchane ja sakte hain. Yeh is par munhasir hai ke tissues X-rays ko kitna mukhtalif jazb karte hain, jo un ki density, motai aur atomic number, aur X-ray ki tawanai par munhasir hai.

Sakht (hard) X-rays (zyada tawanai) haddiyon ki tasveer ke liye use hoti hain; naram (soft) X-rays (kam tawanai) breast jaise naram tissues ke liye behtar hain. Contrast media iodine (Z = 53) ya barium (Z = 56) jaise maddey hain jo X-rays ko achhi tarah jazb karte hain; inhein jism ke khaas hisse numayan karne ke liye injection se diya ya nigla jata hai. Zyada atomic number ki wajah se yeh X-ray ki jazbiyat barha kar un tissues ko saaf numayan karte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: motai x ke saath shiddat I = Io e^(-mu x) ke do curves; naram tissue (chhota mu) ahista aur haddi (bara mu) tezi se girti hai. Daen: oopar se X-rays tissue aur us ke andar haddi se guzarti hain; neeche film par haddi ki jagah safaid (roshan) saya aur baqi film siyah hai.
blocks.caption: X-ray imaging mein attenuation aur contrast (asal khaaka; kitab mein is ki koi shakal nahi).

blocks.title: Attenuation ka formula
blocks.text: Kitab attenuation ka qanoon I = Io x e^(-mu x) chhapti hai, jis mein 'x' motai se zarb jaisa lagta hai. Durust shakal I = Io e^(-mu x) hai: motai sirf exponent mein aati hai.

blocks.prompt: 50 kV par chalne wali tube se X-rays ki kam se kam wavelength maloom karein.

items: X-ray tube: V se tez electrons bhari target se takrate; (K.E.)max = Ve.
Characteristic lakeerein: K-alpha = EL - EK, K-beta = EM - EK; lambda_min = hc/eV tak musalsal bremsstrahlung.
I = Io e^(-mu x); mukhtalif jazbiyat se contrast; iodine aur barium contrast media.
